name: Dangerous Android Permission Requested
description: App requests high-risk Android permissions (e.g. READ_SMS, SEND_SMS, CAMERA, READ_CONTACTS, RECORD_AUDIO, ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION).
reason: Dangerous permissions allow access to sensitive private user data or device resources.
recommendation: Request permissions dynamically at runtime only when strictly necessary and apply the principle of least privilege.

name: Exported Android Component
description: Activity, Service, or Receiver is exported (android:exported="true") without permission protection.
reason: Exported components can be invoked or hijacked by unauthorized third-party apps installed on the same device.
recommendation: Set android:exported="false" unless the component is intentionally part of a public API, or enforce strict custom permissions.

name: Application is Debuggable
reason: Debuggable applications allow attackers to attach jdb debuggers, step through execution, dump memory, and execute arbitrary code.

name: Allow Backup Enabled
reason: Enabling backup allows ADB backup commands to extract private application sandbox data without root privileges.
recommendation: Set android:allowBackup="false" or configure a custom backup rule excluding sensitive data.
